android/build:
Building the Android app

For a Capacitor project. Gradle has to run on Java 21.

Copy the web app in

npm run build && npx cap sync android

Build a debug APK

cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug

The APK is in app/build/outputs/apk/debug/.
git/basics:
Git basics

Save points for a project, on your computer and on GitHub.

Save a checkpoint

git add .
git commit -m "What changed"

See what changed

git status
git log --oneline

Send it to GitHub

git push
git/undo:
Undoing changes

Discard changes to one file

git restore path/to/file

Undo a commit that was pushed

Makes a new commit that reverses it, so history isn't rewritten.

git revert <commit>
